QuestInfo.name: The Soul Collector
QuestInfo.0: Ghosthunter Bob of Ludibrium is complaining that he lost the vacuum that gathers up the spirits in it.
QuestInfo.1: Ghosthunter Bob says once he starts eating something, he focuses on it so hard that he wouldn't notice if someone pickpocketed him. And that is why he didn't notice when his Soul Collector went missing. Help him get it back.
QuestInfo.2: I helped Ghosthunter Bob recover the lost Soul Collector.

0.0: Who did this! Why is it that whenever I take my mind off things, someone steals my stuff??? Can you help me out here?

yes.0: Arrggh, I really don't know what to do. It is true that I am constantly hungry, and it is doubly true that I enjoy eating, but... it is inexcusable for someone to keep stealing my stuff while I am eating!
yes.1: It should be one of these guys... I am sure it's not done by the weaker ones.
yes.2: The Soul Collector I use is chock full of evil spirits, you know! If someone keeps stealing that very important item of mine... I'm very sure someone is being told to take it away from me.
yes.3: Seriously... the one I'm the most suspicious of is the one that keeps moving around me while I'm eating, the monster that moves around on a boat... the Spirit Viking...
yes.4: Can you get rid of 80 Vikings and get my Soul Collectors back? It looks like this, #i4031193#, so grab the right one!

1.0: What? You found my Soul Collector?? Did the Spirit Viking really have it??

yes.0: Thank you so much! I'll make sure I won't lose it now, not after going through all this. I'm very concerned about the possibility of losing it again... man... what should I do THEN?

item.0: Is it too hard to find my Soul Collector? I'm very sure Spirit Viking is the culprit here! My instincts are never wrong! Now please find it for me!

mob.0: Come on, go teach those Vikings a lesson! You'll need to get at least 80 of them to prevent any more harm!
